name: Arlington
summary: A partnership rummy game with wild 2s and Jokers played over 7 hands for total points.
rules_text: Play with two decks plus one Joker; all 2s and Jokers are wild. Deal 13 cards each from a draw pile, no discard pile. On your turn draw one card unless you were stopped. You may trade a natural card from hand for a wild 2 or Joker used as wild in an opponent's meld. If you can lay your contract meld you must; once you have, you may add extra melds or lay off 1-2 cards to own or partner's melds. Then if you have more than one card, show one card to left opponent and ask if they want it, continuing clockwise until taken. Aces and wilds are only offered left. If you take an Ace, 2, or Joker from an opponent, you skip your next draw. Hand ends when a player melds last card and goes out, scoring bonus 100-500 increasing by hand number, plus card points for melds, minus points for cards left in non-rummy hands. Play 7 hands, highest total wins.
